profile.headline: Software Engineer II at PSI
profile.summary: Detail-oriented software engineer with a few years of experience in developing scalable applications and optimizing code architecture. I am exploring challenging career opportunities that provide me the chance to exhibit my critical thinking skills and work ethic in the realm of software development and technology. There are many topics I am excited to continuing to learning about through being exposed to real-world technical operations. I am always open to exploring new roles that introduce me to leading experts in the field as I build my career and strengthen the skills I already have.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
o Generated innovative ideas to problem solve solutions with minimal guidance, from project design and initial planning to execution and maintenance
o Implemented automated testing strategies, resulting in the reduction of post-release bugs

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
o Developed and tested code based on the software requirements specification.
o Collaborated across various teams to gain a deep understanding of different client needs.
o Acquired proficiency in new software libraries including: Flask, OpenCV, Numpy, Tkinter, Django, Docker, and AWS.

positions.title: Technical Sales Specialist
positions.description:
o Researched technical datasheets to recommend notebooks, components, and unique technologies to clients.
o Worked with vendors reps to generate sales towards classrooms, offices, and retailers.
o Managed a large amount of incoming calls and emails while maintaining a clean mailbox with timely responses.

positions.title: Development & Integrations Intern
positions.description:
o Executed tests and protocols for assigned portions of code; Including creating and debugging over 250 Unit tests in F# for the .NET Standard
o Developed scripts to parse Json files and automate tasks for more efficient coding practices
o Shadowed transfer of endpoints from Biztalk to Neuron Service Bus

positions.title: Team Worker
positions.description:
o	Ensured customer satisfaction with home delivery and instore distribution
o	Prepared and delivered pizzas fast and efficiently
o	Stocked and labeled new frozen food in storage

positions.title: Networking Intern
positions.description:
o	Troubleshooted and diagnosed firmware across the system
o	Visited switches and access-points on site to repair wifi connections
o	Purged access points and update networks

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
o	Developed National risk score trending report to compare monthly client performance against State and National trends
o	Validated client data and monthly processing through a QA of the User Interface
o	Learned Oracle SQL to generate client specific reports for 15 clients
o	Extracted, transformed, and loaded data into databases

positions.title: Breakfast Runner
positions.description:
o	Coordinated distribution of meals to guests
o	Cleaned and prepared workspace for upcoming events

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Habitat for Humanity of the Greater Harrisburg Area
volunteerExperiences.description:
o	Attended weekly sessions to create new homes for low income families
o	Learned new techniques and methods of construction and maintenance

company.name: Habitat for Humanity of the Greater Harrisburg Area

volunteerExperiences.description:
o	Provided STEM education to a diverse group of approximately 200 young students
o	Hosted formal scientific presentation for a group of twenty scholars
